sn56.41:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn56.41:1.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, aññataro puriso rājagahā nikkhamitvā lokacintaṃ cintessāmīti yena sumāgavā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṃkami. upasaṃkamitvā sumāgavāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre nisīdi. lokacintaṃ cintento.
sn56.41:1.4: addasā kho bhikkhave, so puriso sumāgavāya pokkharaṇiyā caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ bhisamuḷālaṃ pavisantiṃ.
sn56.41:1.7: yaṃ loke natthi taṃ mayā diṭṭhanti.
sn56.41:2.1: atha kho so bhikkhave, so puriso rājagahaṃ pavisitvā mahājanakāyassa ārocesi.
sn56.41:2.2: ummatto’smi nāmāhaṃ bhante, vicetosmi nāmāhaṃ bhante.
sn56.41:2.3: yaṃ loke natthi taṃ mayā diṭṭhanti.
sn56.41:2.4: yathā kathampana tvaṃ ambho purisa, ummatto kathaṃ viceto
sn56.41:2.5: kiñca loke natthi yaṃ tayā diṭṭhanti.
sn56.41:2.6: idhāhaṃ bhante rājagahā nikkhamitvā lokacintaṃ cintessāmīti yena sumāgavā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṃkamiṃ. upasaṃkamitvā sumāgavāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre nisīdiṃ lokacintaṃ cintento.
sn56.41:2.7: addasaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante, sumāgavāya pokkharaṇiyā caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ bhisamuḷālaṃ pavisantiṃ.
sn56.41:2.8: evaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante, ummatto. evaṃ viceto.
sn56.41:2.9: idañca loke natthi yaṃ mayā diṭṭhanti.
sn56.41:2.10: taggha tvaṃ ambho purisa ummatto, taggha viceto.
sn56.41:2.11: idañca loke natthi yaṃ tayā diṭṭhanti.
sn56.41:3.1: taṃ kho pana bhikkhave, so puriso bhūtaṃ yeva addasa, no abhūtaṃ.
sn56.41:3.3: tasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave, saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu, asurā parājiniṃsu.
sn56.41:3.4: parājitā ca kho bhikkhave, asurā bhītā bhisamuḷālena asurapuraṃ pavisiṃsu. devānaṃ yeva mohayamānā
sn56.41:4.2: sassato lokoti vā asassato lokoti vā, antavā lokoti vā anantavā lokoti vā, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā.
sn56.41:4.4: nesā bhikkhave, cintā atthasaṃhitā nādibrahmacariyakā, na nibbidāya, na virāgāya, na nirodhāya, na upasamāya, na abhiññāya, na sambodhāya, na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn56.41:5.1: cintentā kho tumhe bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkha”nti cinteyyātha, “ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo”ti cinteyyātha, “ayaṃ dukkhanirodho”ti cinteyyātha, “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti cinteyyātha.
sn56.41:5.3: esā bhikkhave, cintā atthasaṃhitā esā ādibrahmacariyakā, esā nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn56.41:6.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
